title: From Seva to steadier practice
subtitle: A deliberate path through seva
description: Guru joins service to humility, honest labor, and offering rather than display. This path starts with short guidance, opens the topic fully, and then stays long enough with Gurbani to change pace.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Selfless service becomes a way of union, not a way of building a self-image.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Serve without building a story about being the servant.
